description: Export one of the user's Canva designs (designId or its Canva link) and save the files into the Hermoso Library, ready to post, schedule or use as ad creative. format png (default), jpg, pdf, mp4, gif or pptx; pages [1,3] for some pages; quality = 1-100 for JPG or e.g. vertical_1080p for MP4 (defaults follow the design's shape); proQuality:true for Canva's pro quality (fails on unlicensed premium elements). Free.
name: export_canva_design
title: Export a Canva design
